output.review_comment: The implementation fixes the tests, but the docstring was not updated to reflect the actual behavior. The agent itself identified that the after-colon capitalization logic contradicts the docstring but didn't update the docstring. Please update the docstring to accurately describe all three rules: (1) preserving mixed-case words, (2) capitalizing first/last words and words after colons, and (3) capitalizing other words. This will ensure the documentation stays in sync with the implementation.
